meta.description: The world where nobody gets hurt is complete!

units.rawText: At Kurenoyume Shrine in the Oasis.
units.displayText: At Kurenoyume Shrine in the Oasis.

units.rawText: I see, so you came from another world line, Oka... Kyouma-sensei.
units.displayText: I see, so you came from another world line, Oka... Kyouma-sensei.

spans.text: I see, so you came from another world line, Oka... Kyouma-sensei.

units.rawText: So you've sent a second D-Mail already...
units.displayText: So you've sent a second D-Mail already...

spans.text: So you've sent a second D-Mail already...

units.rawText: According to what Okabe said, we managed to avoid Urushibara-kun getting hurt and Samidare getting broken.
units.displayText: According to what Okabe said, we managed to avoid Urushibara-kun getting hurt and Samidare getting broken.

spans.text: According to what Okabe said, we managed to avoid Urushibara-kun getting hurt and Samidare getting broken.

units.rawText: No wonder Okabe suddenly rushed over and started stripping Luka. It gave us all a scare.
units.displayText: No wonder Okabe suddenly rushed over and started stripping Luka. It gave us all a scare.

spans.text: No wonder Okabe suddenly rushed over and started stripping Luka. It gave us all a scare.

units.rawText: At this point, I feel a pair of cold gazes boring into my back... For the sake of my safety, I'd better change the topic.
units.displayText: At this point, I feel a pair of cold gazes boring into my back... For the sake of my safety, I'd better change the topic.

units.rawText: Well, let's just leave this aside for now.
units.displayText: Well, let's just leave this aside for now.

spans.text: Well, let's just leave this aside for now.

units.rawText: Although, I'd like to clarify one thing. I was on the Oasis' outskirts in the previous world line, so why did I come here after sending the D-Mail?
units.displayText: Although, I'd like to clarify one thing. I was on the Oasis' outskirts in the previous world line, so why did I come here after sending the D-Mail?

units.rawText: Ah, that's because Kimie-san mentioned the shrine where she spent her time... I was interested, so...
units.displayText: Ah, that's because Kimie-san mentioned the shrine where she spent her time... I was interested, so...

spans.text: Ah, that's because Kimie-san mentioned the shrine where she spent her time... I was interested, so...

units.rawText: This shrine really is different from Yanabayashi Shrine. Kimie-san and Erika-san also had very interesting experiences to share...
units.displayText: This shrine really is different from Yanabayashi Shrine. Kimie-san and Erika-san also had very interesting experiences to share...

spans.text: This shrine really is different from Yanabayashi Shrine. Kimie-san and Erika-san also had very interesting experiences to share...

units.rawText: I too was very glad to have another miko over in Kurenoyume Shrine.
units.displayText: I too was very glad to have another miko over in Kurenoyume Shrine.

spans.text: I too was very glad to have another miko over in Kurenoyume Shrine.

units.rawText: After considering Luka's wishes and ensuring his safety, we asked the Professor to meet us at the shrine.
units.displayText: After considering Luka's wishes and ensuring his safety, we asked the Professor to meet us at the shrine.

spans.text: After considering Luka's wishes and ensuring his safety, we asked the Professor to meet us at the shrine.

units.rawText: In that case, you must have turned up here because Luka was in a different place, and so our meeting place changed.
units.displayText: In that case, you must have turned up here because Luka was in a different place, and so our meeting place changed.

spans.text: In that case, you must have turned up here because Luka was in a different place, and so our meeting place changed.

units.rawText: I see, that makes sense now.
units.displayText: I see, that makes sense now.

spans.text: I see, that makes sense now.

units.rawText: Erika, what do you make of this?
units.displayText: Erika, what do you make of this?

spans.text: Erika, what do you make of this?

units.rawText: Hm... Well, if Lukako was a girl, you could consider this an ordinary teacher-student interaction.
units.displayText: Hm... Well, if Lukako was a girl, you could consider this an ordinary teacher-student interaction.

spans.text: Hm... Well, if Lukako was a girl, you could consider this an ordinary teacher-student interaction.

units.rawText: However, now that we know he's a boy, it's become a hot topic!
units.displayText: However, now that we know he's a boy, it's become a hot topic!

spans.text: However, now that we know he's a boy, it's become a hot topic!

units.rawText: W-Wait a minute! Are you looking at it from that angle? Why are this shrine maiden and this nun talking about things that seem entirely inappropriate for their positions?
units.displayText: W-Wait a minute! Are you looking at it from that angle? Why are this shrine maiden and this nun talking about things that seem entirely inappropriate for their positions?

spans.text: W-Wait a minute! Are you looking at it from that angle? Why are this shrine maiden and this nun talking about things that seem entirely inappropriate for their positions?

units.rawText: Truly you are a lady of culture, Erika-san. What about you, Kurisu-san? What do you think?
units.displayText: Truly you are a lady of culture, Erika-san. What about you, Kurisu-san? What do you think?

spans.text: Truly you are a lady of culture, Erika-san. What about you, Kurisu-san? What do you think?

units.rawText: Ehh?! Why did you suddenly mention me?
units.displayText: Ehh?! Why did you suddenly mention me?

spans.text: Ehh?! Why did you suddenly mention me?

units.rawText: I've got some good titles in my room pertaining to the subject!
units.displayText: I've got some good titles in my room pertaining to the subject!

spans.text: I've got some good titles in my room pertaining to the subject!

units.rawText: A-ah, I, er, you, you've gotten it wrong! I, I'm not a, a fujo or anything!
units.displayText: A-ah, I, er, you, you've gotten it wrong! I, I'm not a, a fujo or anything!

spans.text: A-ah, I, er, you, you've gotten it wrong! I, I'm not a, a fujo or anything!

units.rawText: Oh? In that case, please do not go to any trouble on our account.
units.displayText: Oh? In that case, please do not go to any trouble on our account.

spans.text: Oh? In that case, please do not go to any trouble on our account.

units.rawText: Don't smile in such a mysterious and easily misinterpreted way! This miko looks so much like Luka but her true nature is anything but!
units.displayText: Don't smile in such a mysterious and easily misinterpreted way! This miko looks so much like Luka but her true nature is anything but!

spans.text: Don't smile in such a mysterious and easily misinterpreted way! This miko looks so much like Luka but her true nature is anything but!

units.rawText: Speaking of which, you do not seem surprised by Luka's situation, Professor... Did Okabe-san tell you about this beforehand?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, you do not seem surprised by Luka's situation, Professor... Did Okabe-san tell you about this beforehand?

spans.text: Speaking of which, you do not seem surprised by Luka's situation, Professor... Did Okabe-san tell you about this beforehand?

units.rawText: Hm? But his sex was obvious at a glance, no?
units.displayText: Hm? But his sex was obvious at a glance, no?

spans.text: Hm? But his sex was obvious at a glance, no?

units.rawText: I wonder if I should applaud you for that...
units.displayText: I wonder if I should applaud you for that...

spans.text: I wonder if I should applaud you for that...

units.rawText: No, I can't let them keep chattering on like this! As the resident insane mad scientist, I need to regain the initiative!
units.displayText: No, I can't let them keep chattering on like this! As the resident insane mad scientist, I need to regain the initiative!

spans.text: No, I can't let them keep chattering on like this! As the resident insane mad scientist, I need to regain the initiative!

units.rawText: You lot over there! Let's finish our work before engaging in idle banter!
units.displayText: You lot over there! Let's finish our work before engaging in idle banter!

spans.text: You lot over there! Let's finish our work before engaging in idle banter!

units.rawText: Muhahaha! Do you see now, assistant? The plans of a mad scientist are foolproof!
units.displayText: Muhahaha! Do you see now, assistant? The plans of a mad scientist are foolproof!

spans.text: Muhahaha! Do you see now, assistant? The plans of a mad scientist are foolproof!

units.rawText: Yes, yes, I know, I know.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, I know, I know.

spans.text: Yes, yes, I know, I know.

units.rawText: Hm? What's this? I did perfectly create a world where Lukako and Samidare were unhurt. Isn't that too bland of a response?
units.displayText: Hm? What's this? I did perfectly create a world where Lukako and Samidare were unhurt. Isn't that too bland of a response?

units.rawText: It's too early to celebrate when you haven't found everyone yet.
units.displayText: It's too early to celebrate when you haven't found everyone yet.

spans.text: It's too early to celebrate when you haven't found everyone yet.

units.rawText: Indeed, now there is only one person left. That being the case, let us set out to find Faris!
units.displayText: Indeed, now there is only one person left. That being the case, let us set out to find Faris!

units.displayText: My comrade, where is the last signal?

spans.text: My comrade, where is the last signal?

spans.text: Looks like you've almost finished assembling your friends scattered throughout the Oasis. Let me see...

units.rawText: She should be in the shopping street. Hm? Mayuri's there, too?

spans.text: She should be in the shopping street. Hm? Mayuri's there, too?

units.rawText: What? Has Mayuri already met up with Faris? I can't believe she didn't tell me.
units.displayText: What? Has Mayuri already met up with Faris? I can't believe she didn't tell me.

spans.text: What? Has Mayuri already met up with Faris? I can't believe she didn't tell me.

units.rawText: Well, since we know where everyone is now, I'd like to verify a guess of mine.
units.displayText: Well, since we know where everyone is now, I'd like to verify a guess of mine.

spans.text: Well, since we know where everyone is now, I'd like to verify a guess of mine.

units.rawText: By which you mean, "Everyone's position in Magrasea after crossing over is related to how close they were to Future Gadget No. 099 before crossing over, right?"
units.displayText: By which you mean, "Everyone's position in Magrasea after crossing over is related to how close they were to Future Gadget No. 099 before crossing over, right?"

units.rawText: Indeed. Earlier, we already confirmed that besides Okabe hitting his head on Future Gadget No. 099, Hashida, who was the closest to Future Gadget No. 099, was also the closest to the Future Gadget Lab after crossing over.
units.displayText: Indeed. Earlier, we already confirmed that besides Okabe hitting his head on Future Gadget No. 099, Hashida, who was the closest to Future Gadget No. 099, was also the closest to the Future Gadget Lab after crossing over.

units.displayText: Um... I think I was behind the table...

spans.text: Um... I think I was behind the table...

units.rawText: This makes things much clearer. Thank you, Professor. Although... Hm, it does look like kind of a mess.

spans.text: This makes things much clearer. Thank you, Professor. Although... Hm, it does look like kind of a mess.

units.rawText: Luka, am I right to say your position, as well as that of Okabe, Hashida, and Faris were roughly like this before crossing over?

spans.text: Luka, am I right to say your position, as well as that of Okabe, Hashida, and Faris were roughly like this before crossing over?

units.rawText: Yes! It was a little messy back then, I was scared so I took a couple of steps back, and then I passed out... I should have been over here.

units.rawText: Thank you, Urushibara-kun. This has not only verified my guess but further supplemented it; everyone's positions before crossing over correspond to our locations after crossing over on a one-to-one basis.
